notes: The Quiet Spire: a third-person stealth-platformer in a dark stone courtyard. Collect five shards, including three on low pillars and one on the ziggurat, plus one at ground level far from the centre, then reach the crown to light the beacon. Three patrolling watchers detect the player only through unobstructed line of sight within a cone and range; pillars and the ziggurat block their gaze. Being seen fills a meter; a full meter returns the player to the gate with shards kept. Built with raw WebGL 1 and no dependencies: procedural box geometry, Lambert shading with a moving lantern point light and distance fog, axis-separated AABB collision with jump buffering, a camera that pulls in around geometry and follows movement when idle, positional sentinel hum audio, adaptive render resolution, and context-loss handling. Touch uses a left-side stick, right-side camera drag and a Jump button. Known limits: one short authored level, primitive box meshes with no textures or imported assets, and no tested mobile performance budget. Test status: JavaScript syntax was checked with node --check; the game was not run in a browser in this environment, so frame rate and interaction feel are unverified.
